plan.title: Greenfield onboarding does not auto-start setup phases when USER.md already exists

narratives.Description: Greenfield onboarding does not auto-start setup phases when USER.md already exists
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

On a fresh (greenfield) project immediately after installing deft, simply loading `AGENTS.md` does **not** kick off the setup phases when a `USER.md` already exists on the machine (e.g. from a prior install or another project). The agent reads `AGENTS.md`, but the "First Session" routing into the project-definition phase (Phase 2) never fires, so the user is left without `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` and no prompt to create it.

## Expected behavior

Per the `AGENTS.md` "First Session" contract and `content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md`:

- **USER.md missing** -> start Phase 1 (user preferences)
- **USER.md exists, `PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` missing** -> start Phase 2 (project definition)

So on a greenfield project where `USER.md` already exists but `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` does not, the agent should automatically enter the setup skill at Phase 2 and walk the user through generating the project definition.

## Actual behavior

After install, when the agent loads `AGENTS.md` on a greenfield project and `USER.md` already exists, the setup phases do **not** start. The agent neither reads `content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md` nor begins Phase 2, and the project is left without a `PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json`.

## Repro

1. Have an existing `USER.md` at the platform default path (`~/.config/deft/USER.md` or `%APPDATA%\deft\USER.md`).
2. Install deft into a fresh/greenfield project that has no `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` and no lifecycle folders.
3. Start a session / load `AGENTS.md`.
4. Observe: setup phases (specifically Phase 2 project definition) do not auto-start.

## Notes / suspected area

- The "First Session" detection block in `AGENTS.md` (and the managed-section mirror) and the routing into `content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md` Phase 2.
- The "USER.md exists, PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json missing -> Phase 2" branch appears not to be reliably triggering on greenfield + pre-existing USER.md.
- Worth confirming whether this is a detection gap (greenfield state not recognized) vs. a routing gap (state recognized but Phase 2 not entered automatically).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On a greenfield project with an existing `USER.md` and no `PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json`, loading `AGENTS.md` reliably routes the agent into the setup skill at Phase 2.
- [ ] The behavior is covered by a deterministic test where feasible (state detection + routing).
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Surface: the 'First Session' detection block in AGENTS.md (+ its managed-section mirror content/templates/agents-entry.md) and the routing into content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md Phase 2. 1. Make the 'USER.md exists, PROJECT-DEFINITION missing -> Phase 2' branch reliably fire on greenfield + pre-existing USER.md; tighten the instruction so the agent auto-enters the setup skill at Phase 2 rather than only reading AGENTS.md. 2. Post-#2112, reference xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json (NOT the legacy vbrief path the issue body cites). 3. Per #1309, mirror the AGENTS.md change into content/templates/agents-entry.md and run `task agents:refresh`. 4. Add a deterministic test of the state-detection + routing where feasible.
